items.raw_excerpt: ProRail has announced there will be no trains to or from Amsterdam central station on Saturday, October 3 due to maintenance works. The time table on Sunday, October 5 and Monday, October 6 will also significantly altered, the national rail operator said. The work is part of ongoing renovations at the capital’s main train station. Currently it services around 200,000 travelers per day, one of the busiest in the country. That number is expected to grow to 275,000 per day....
items.summary_en: ProRail says there will be no trains to or from Amsterdam Central Station on Saturday, October 3. The work is part of a big renovation at the busiest station in the country. Trains on Sunday, October 5, and Monday, October 6, will also run very different timetables.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan plans to add five hours to motorcycle training courses starting Jan. 1, 2027, and pilot on-road motorcycle license tests in selected regions beginning in October that year, under draft regulations announced Wednesday by the Ministry of Transportation and Communications (MOTC).
items.summary_en: Taiwan will add five hours to motorcycle training courses from January 1, 2027. The transport ministry also plans to run road tests for motorcycle licenses in some areas from October 2027. The rules are still a draft.
items.summary_ko: 대만은 2027년 1월 1일부터 오토바이 운전 교육 시간을 5시간 늘릴 계획이다. 교통부는 같은 해 10월부터 일부 지역에서 실제 도로 위 오토바이 면허 시험을 시범 운영할 예정이다. 지금은 초안 단계다.
items.title_en: Taiwan plans longer motorcycle training and road tests

items.raw_excerpt: Barolong are one of Batswana's communities which are found in different villages across SA and Bots
items.summary_en: Montshioa is celebrating 25 years as leader of the Barolong boo Ratshidi community. The Barolong are one of the Tswana communities found in villages across South Africa and Botswana. He has led the group for a quarter of a century.

items.title_en: Montshioa Marks 25 Years Leading the Barolong boo Ratshidi
